borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
description: Construction of a ground floor side infill, a first floor rear extension, and a two storey side extension to facilitate the conversion of the existing dwelling into 2 self-contained flats (1 × 3-bedroom and 1 × 2-bedroom)
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be commenced before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby approved shall only be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:

  • Amended Site Location Plan and Existing and Proposed Block Plans (drawing no.: FF-R05, revision A, received: 02/01/2026)
  • Amended Proposed Floor Plans and Elevations (drawing no.: FF-R02, revision A, received: 02/01/2026)
  • Amended Cycle Storage Details (drawing no.: FF-R04, revision A, received: 02/01/2026)
  • Amended Design and Access Statement (received: 19/12/2025)
  • Proposed Refuse Storage Details (drawing no.: FF-R03, revision A, dated: 12/11/2025)

No other drawings or documents apply.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing dwellinghouse.

Prior to commencement of the development the applicant must enter into a s.278 agreement (Highways Act 1980). This agreement shall secure a scheme of highway works, including the reinstatement of the kerb on Farrance Road and associated road markings and implement all off-site highway works to an agreed schedule prior to occupation. All highway works must be completed prior to first occupation of the development.

Construction Logistics Plan a)  Prior to commencement of the development, a CLP in line with the TfL guidelines shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Council. The details shall include the numbers, size and routes of construction vehicles, provisions within/around the site to ensure that all vehicles associated with the construction works are properly managed to prevent any unwanted disruption to other highway users, and other matters relating to traffic management to be agreed with the licencing officers of the council. b)  The approved details shall be implemented throughout the project period and any changes to the document must be reported back to the council’s planning and highways department.
